signals.title_or_quote: Commit message generation fails with promptFiltered (422) on innocuous diff
signals.why_relevant: User hit a content filter trying to generate a commit message for a whitespace-only change.
signals.drafted_reply: The promptFiltered 422 on gpt-4o-mini is a known Copilot content-filter false-positive — it fires on diffs containing certain tokens (SQL keywords, file paths, even some variable names) that trip the RAI filter regardless of intent. Until Microsoft fixes the classifier, the practical workaround is to stage smaller, more focused hunks so the prompt stays below whatever threshold is triggering it. You can also try switching to a model you can select manually in Copilot settings, since the commit generator is hardcoded to gpt-4o-mini which may have a stricter filter profile. If you want to sidestep the cloud filter entirely, I built gitwhisper ({APP_URL}), a VS Code extension that can run against a local Ollama model so your diff never leaves the machine.

rescore.why: The author is directly struggling with GitHub Copilot's commit message generation failing due to content filter errors (422 promptFiltered), which is exactly the pain point this app solves by offering an alternative commit message generator including a local-model path.
